about: A gas regulator reduces high cylinder pressure to a steady working pressure. Single-stage regulators are simple and suit short jobs, while two-stage regulators hold delivery pressure more steadily as the cylinder empties. A double-gauge regulator shows both cylinder contents and outlet pressure.

Use a regulator made for the specific gas — oxygen, acetylene, hydrogen and inert gases each need the correct connection and material. Never use oil or grease on oxygen regulators, and replace regulators that leak or have damaged gauges.
